# ThailandBiker.club

> The ultimate riding companion for motorcycle enthusiasts in Thailand. Discover curated routes, riding spots, events, and practical guides built for the expat biker community.

## About

ThailandBiker.club is a mobile app and companion website that helps motorcycle riders navigate the Thai riding scene. All listings are rider-reviewed before going live.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thailandbiker.club/): App overview, features, screenshots, and download links
- [Support](https://thailandbiker.club/support.html): Contact form and help resources
- [Privacy Policy](https://thailandbiker.club/privacy-policy.html): Data collection and PDPA compliance
- [Terms of Use](https://thailandbiker.club/terms-of-use.html): App and website usage conditions

## App Features

- **Places** — Find dealerships, garages, gear shops, and rentals with rider-verified listings
- **Trips** — Curated scenic routes across Thailand with elevation, twistiness ratings, and rider notes
- **Events** — Local riding community meets, rallies, charity rides, and shop nights sorted by region and date
- **Guides** — Practical information for foreign riders: licenses, insurance, bike importing, customs, and accident advice

## Target Audience

Expatriate and foreign motorcycle riders living in or visiting Thailand. Also relevant to local Thai riders seeking a curated, community-reviewed directory.
